name: local-rag-demonstrator
description: Local RAG Architecture Demonstrator using Gemma 4, EmbeddingGemma 2, Chroma DB, and Node.js

scripts.dev: concurrently -n chroma,server,client -c magenta,cyan,green "npm run chroma" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm --workspace server run build && npm --workspace client run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n chroma,server -c magenta,cyan "npm run chroma" "npm --workspace server run start"
